It was a dark time when there weren't any more movies, and it blew our minds that there could be more.|[[Dave Filoni]]|{{SW|url=news/who-is-thrawn|text=Who Is Thrawn?|nolive=1}}}} '''''Heir to the Empire''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]]. It is the first installment of ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]'', and it was first published in [[May]] [[1991]] by [[Bantam Spectra]]. The novel is set in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], five years after [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], and it introduces the trilogy's eponymous villain, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. ''Heir to the Empire'' received several audiobook versions, and the novel was also adapted into a [[1995]] comic book [[Star Wars: Heir to the Empire (comic series)|''Star Wars: Heir to the Empire'' comic adaptation]]. In [[2011]], a special [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|''20th Anniversary Edition'']] of the novel was published by [[Del Rey]]. The novel topped the New York Times Best Seller List in Fiction June 30, 1991. As of 2017, the trilogy had sold more than 15 million copies.
